text:
Once upon a time, in a big sky, there was a comet. The comet was unusual. It was very big and very bright. It moved fast across the sky. Everyone looked at it and said, "Wow!"
One day, the comet had a big problem. It hit something in the sky. The comet split into many little pieces. The pieces fell down, down, down from the sky. People were scared.
The pieces of the comet fell on the ground. They made big holes. Houses and trees were gone. People were sad and cried. The unusual comet was no more, and the day was very bad.

One day, a little boy named Tim and his dog, Max, went for a walk. They gazed at the big, yellow sun going down. The sky was turning dark. Tim and Max were excited for their night walk.
They saw a big tree and went to sit under it. Tim looked at Max and said, "Max, are you having fun?" Max barked happily. He was impatient to keep walking and wagged his tail.
Tim and Max walked and walked until they saw their house. They were tired but happy. They went inside, had a big drink of water, and went to bed. They couldn't wait for their next walk.

One day, a girl named Sue wanted to make a pretty picture. She had many colors to use. She had red, blue, and yellow. Sue wanted to make a new color. She thought it would be fun to mix red and blue. When she did, she made a pretty purple color.
Sue was very happy with her new color. She wanted to make another color. This time, she mixed blue and yellow. She made a nice green color. Sue was successful in making new colors. She wanted to show her friends.
Sue thought of something special. She found a shiny copper penny. She put the penny on her picture. The copper penny made her picture even more pretty. Sue was so proud of her picture. She showed it to her friends, and they all loved it too.

One day, a little dog named Spot went for a walk in the park. It was a very hot day, so Spot looked for some shade under a big tree. As he sat in the cool shade, he saw a big cat named Fluffy coming near him.
Spot was scared of Fluffy because she was much bigger than him. Spot said, "Please don't hurt me, I am just a little dog." Fluffy looked at Spot and said, "I won't hurt you. I am just hot and want to sit in the shade too."
So, Spot and Fluffy sat together in the shade. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. Both of them were scared and started to shake. They looked around and saw a big ball bouncing towards them. A little boy came running after the ball and said, "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to scare you!"
Spot and Fluffy were not scared anymore. They all played with the ball together and had lots of fun. From that day on, Spot and Fluffy became best friends and were never scared of each other again.

Once upon a time, there was a brave cat named Tom. He loved to solve mysteries. One day, he saw a big box in the yard. Tom was very curious about the box. He wanted to find out what was inside.
Tom went to the box and tried to open it. But it was hard to open. He tried to strike it with his paw. Suddenly, the box opened, and something unexpected happened. A little bird flew out of the box. Tom was very surprised.
The bird was very happy to be free. It thanked Tom for being brave and helping it. The bird and Tom became good friends. They played together and solved mysteries. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a kind doctor. The doctor liked to help people feel better. Every day, many people came to see the doctor. They were called patients. The doctor was very patient with them.
One of the patients was a little girl. The little girl liked to make things. She made regular visits to the doctor. The doctor liked to see her. She always made the doctor smile.
One day, the little girl made a picture for the doctor. It was a picture of them both, with big smiles. The doctor was so happy. The doctor hung the picture on the wall. Now, the doctor and the little girl were always together, making each other smile.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty, yellow butterfly. The butterfly liked to fly in the sunny sky. She had many friends, like the bee and the ladybug.
One day, the butterfly saw a big, green leaf. She was very tired. So, she said to herself, "I will lie on this leaf and rest for a while." And she did just that.
As she lay on the leaf, a little boy came by. He saw the yellow butterfly and said, "Hi, pretty butterfly! You look nice on the green leaf." The butterfly said, "Thank you, little boy. I like to rest here." They became friends and played together every day. The little boy and the yellow butterfly were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a clever little boy named Tim. Tim loved to imagine wild adventures. He would pretend to be a brave hero, saving the day.
One sunny day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He saw a big tree and imagined it was a wild castle. He climbed the tree like a clever monkey. Tim felt like he was on top of the world!
Tim's mom watched him play and smiled. She knew her clever boy was having a great time. They went home after a fun day at the park, and Tim couldn't wait to imagine more wild adventures tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to joke and play with his friends. One day, Tim and his friends went to a fun fair. They were very excited to play games and win prizes.
At the fair, there was a big game where you could win a prize. Tim and his friends played the game, but they could not win. They were upset. They tried again and again, but they still could not win the prize. Tim had an idea. He decided to tell a joke to make his friends happy again.
Tim told the joke, and his friends laughed. They felt better and played the game one more time. This time, they won the prize! But when they opened the prize box, they found it was empty. They were very surprised. The game man said, "The real prize was the fun you had together and the laughter from your joke!" Tim and his friends learned that sometimes the best prize is not a toy, but the fun and love we share with our friends. And they all went home happy.

One day, a big, warm cat named Kitty lay in the sun. She liked to lay on the soft grass. She saw a small cut on her paw. "Oh no!" said Kitty. "I need a band to cover the cut."
Kitty went to her friend, Dog. "Dog, can you help me find a band for my cut?" she asked. Dog said, "Yes, let's look in the house." They went inside and looked everywhere. They could not find a band.
Just then, they heard a noise outside. They went to see what it was. It was a bird! The bird had a band in its beak. "Here, Kitty," said the bird. "I found this for you." Kitty was so happy and surprised! She thanked the bird and put the band on her cut. Kitty, Dog, and Bird became the best of friends.
